outline:
本課程旨在使學生深入了解當前最新科技發展下各類顯示器之運作原理與技術趨勢，同時探討相關產業的發展動向。課程內容自色彩科學與工程基礎出發，系統性介紹薄膜電晶體(TFT)、液晶顯示器(LCD)、有機發光二極體(OLED)、反射式顯示器、頭戴式AR/VR 顯示器，以及觸控面板等相關顯示技術。
This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the operating principles and technological trends of modern display systems under the latest advancements in science and technology. It also explores the development and perspectives of the display industry. Starting from the fundamentals of color science and engineering, the course systematically introduces various display technologies, including thin-film transistors (TFT), liquid crystal displays (LCD), organic light-emitting diodes (OLED), reflective displays, headmounted AR/VR displays, and touch panels, enabling students to build a well-rounded knowledge base and insight into display technology applications.

(a) 第5~6 週 (b)TFT電晶體與LCD顯示器/ Thin Film Transistors and Liquid Crystal Displays
(a) 第7~8 週 (b)LED顯示器/ Light-Emitting Diodes
(a) 第9 週 (b)期中考/ Midterm
(a) 第10~11 週 (b)OLED顯示器/ Organic Light-Emitting Devices
(a) 第12~13 週(b)反射式與觸控式顯示器/ Reflective Displays and Touch Panel Technology
(a) 第14~15週 (b)AR VR顯示器/ Fundamentals of Head-Mounted Displays for Virtual and Augmented Reality
(a) 第16~18 週 (b)期末報告/ Final Presentation
